milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the polished granite blocks and face them to demonstrate they have found them. The target is the polished granite on the stone brick structure facade at spawn-relative (5, 1, 5), which is the most prominent and visible location. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the blocks.
